description.en: Adds Tavily's hosted remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) to DeepSeek Harness as a patch-only bundle with no runtime code and no dependencies, registering the mcp__tavily__tavily-search, tavily-extract, tavily-map, tavily-crawl and tavily-research tools. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY environment variable, and a rate-limited keyless mode is documented for users without a key.
description.zh: 以 patch-only 插件包的形式把 Tavily 托管的远程 MCP 服务器（Streamable HTTP）接入 DeepSeek Harness，无运行时代码、无依赖，注册 mcp__tavily__tavily-search、tavily-extract、tavily-map、tavily-crawl、tavily-research 五个工具。API Key 从环境变量 TAVILY_API_KEY 读取，文档中也给出了无需 Key 的限速 keyless 模式。
